subject: Executive headcount: Q2 hiring plan sign-offs and comp bands
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q2 exec hires: request for sign-off (2 roles)

Laura —

Sharing the Q2 executive headcount packet for sign-off. We are asking for approval to open and make offers for two roles this quarter:

- EVP Product (1.0 FTE) — replace and expand scope; comp band E3 (base $320k–$420k, target package incl. equity)
- Head of Partnerships (1.0 FTE) — new role to lead channel GTM; comp band E2 (base $210k–$270k)

Attached: Q2_exec_hc_matrix_v3.xlsx (headcount impact / hiring timeline), CompBand_Executive_Levels.pdf (finalized bands), Offer_Template_EVPL1.docx (template for EVP level).

Ask: please sign off on hiring and confirm we are aligned on proposed comp bands and any budget constraints. Marcus has candidate shortlist and Greenleaf Partners is ready to submit offers pending this approval.

Timeline: target offer window 3/08–3/12 to close before next board update.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 exec hires: request for sign-off (2 roles)

Marcus —

Thanks for the packet and the clear timeline. High-level: I am supportive of both hires in principle. A couple of stipulations before green light to extend offers: 

1) EVP Product: I need confirmation that the target comp (total cash + equity) stays inside the E3 band. If the candidate requires a stretch above $420k base, route as an exception with a 2-line justification and a finance sign-off.
2) Head of Partnerships: can we compress the interview loop to two exec panels? Time-to-offer matters here.
3) Please confirm org impacts in the attached matrix (headcount phasing) — I want to make sure ops costs show up in the Q2 forecast.

Assuming those are addressed, you have my provisional approval to proceed with verbal offers. Formal offer signatures should wait until David confirms budget availability.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 exec hires: request for sign-off (2 roles)

Laura / Marcus —

Quick update from Talent: Greenleaf has two EVP-caliber candidates in active negotiation; both have signaling around total comp in the $430k–475k total cash range (base + cash bonus). One can be tightened to band with an equity uplift; the other is asking for base slightly above E3. If you'd prefer strict banding, we will focus on the candidate who can be adjusted.

For Head of Partnerships, we have a strong internal referral who would accept within the E2 band; we can expedite interviews on 3/04 and 3/05. 

Next steps recommended:
- Marcus to confirm which EVP candidate to prioritize (A vs B).
- If EVP requires >E3, Priya will prepare an 'exception memo' with candidate rationale and comp model for Laura + David.
- If approved, Talent will send a draft offer (using Offer_Template_EVPL1.docx) and route to PayrollOps/legal for DocuSign.

Attachments: candidate_compsheet_greenleaf.xlsx (pipeline summary) — internal only.

Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Talent, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 exec hires: request for sign-off (2 roles)

Laura / team —

Finance position: we can fund both hires within the Q2 headcount envelope IF the EVP total comp is managed at or below a $460k total cash + equity construct and we push some hiring spend into Q3 for two non-critical IC roles (per the matrix). If the EVP candidate requires base > $420k we need the exception memo and updated FP&A forecast to show runway impact and OPEX phasing.

Also note: company policy requires an approvals packet for exec offers >$400k total cash signed off by CFO and COO. Please route the DocuSign envelope with the approval checkbox.

I will not block verbal offers; final signature to follow when the packet arrives.

-David
David Kim
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, PayrollOps <payroll@payrollops.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 exec hires: request for sign-off (2 roles)

All —

Final sign-off from my side: proceed with verbal offers for both roles. Conditions: 
- EVP offer: extend verbal at $420k base (within E3). If the candidate counters above band, we pause and evaluate an exception memo (Priya).
- Partnerships: extend formal written offer at midpoint of E2 band.

Marcus / Priya, please:
1) Prepare the formal offer and upload to the Drive folder (link below).
2) Route the DocuSign envelope to David and me for signature (use the DocuSign link in the packet).
3) Copy PayrollOps (payroll@payrollops.com) to start compensation setup and new-hire onboarding checklist.
4) Mark hires in the hiring tracker (JIRA SUP-2103) and set the start date tentatively for 4/01 for the EVP and 4/15 for Partnerships.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qX_exeCHCmatrix
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/sign?token=abc123DEF

Thanks team — get offers out this week. Keep me posted on acceptance.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
